meta.title: Zaritzki Fine Dentistry — private dental practice in Berlin
meta.description: A private dental practice in Berlin Mitte and Charlottenburg. Unhurried appointments, Monday to Friday 08:00–20:00, for privately insured and self-paying patients.

hero.headline: A calmer kind of dental visit
hero.lede: Walk the whole appointment before you book it — the door, the lounge, the conversation, the room, and what it costs when you leave.
hero.qualifier: Privately insured and self-paying patients · Monday to Friday, 08:00–20:00

lounge.headline: You will not be kept waiting in a queue
lounge.body: The room you wait in should be furnished, not fitted out.
lounge.hours: 08:00–20:00, Monday to Friday — appointments before work and after it.

talk.headline: Nothing happens until we've talked
talk.body: Your first appointment is a conversation and an examination. You leave knowing what you need, what it will cost, and what happens if you do nothing.
talk.noPrices: We do not publish a price list. Private dental fees in Germany are set under the GOZ and depend on the treatment plan, so a fixed figure would be a guess. You get a written estimate before anything is agreed.

treatments.implantologie: replacing a tooth at the root

room.headline: Lamplight, not a light in your eyes
room.body: The surgery should look like the rest of the practice. Same wood, same lamps, same quiet — with the 3D imaging, microscopes and 3D scanners we already use, where the work actually needs them.

leaving.headline: What it costs, said plainly
leaving.body: We are a private practice. That is what makes the time and the rooms possible — and it means we can only treat you if you are privately insured or paying yourself.
leaving.privateBody: Billed per GOZ. You receive a written estimate before treatment begins.
leaving.selfBody: A written estimate before anything is agreed.
leaving.gkvBody: We cannot treat statutory patients. Said here rather than after you have booked.

closing.headline: Ready when you are
closing.body: New patients are welcome at both practices.

footer.tagline: A private dental practice in Berlin for privately insured and self-paying patients.
